title: DE-01 Cross-Service Evidence Report
description: Machine-readable shape of the DE-01 runner's own JSON report (tools/de01/report.py::emit_json_report). $defs.CanonicalStatus below is a same-document local $def, not an independently-authored second copy of the vocabulary: a plain `jsonschema.validate(instance, schema)` call (this file's own <verify> contract, and the invocation every operator/CI runs) cannot resolve a cross-file $ref to spec/evidence-contract.schema.json without a caller-supplied Registry, since jsonschema 4.18+ requires explicit retrieval for any $ref outside the current document. tools/de01/tests/test_de01_runner.py::test_report_schema_canonical_status_matches_contract_schema asserts this enum stays byte-identical to spec/evidence-contract.schema.json's $defs.CanonicalStatus.enum, so a drift is caught mechanically rather than by review alone -- $defs.CanonicalStatus.enum in spec/evidence-contract.schema.json remains the single authored source of truth; this is a pinned mirror, not a second authority.

CanonicalStatus.description: Pinned mirror of spec/evidence-contract.schema.json's $defs.CanonicalStatus.enum (D-02's frozen 8-member vocabulary) -- see this schema's top-level description for why this is a same-document $def rather than a cross-file $ref.

de01ReportVersion.description: Version of this report's own shape.

generatedAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of when this report was generated.

fixtureVersion.description: fixtures/golden/MANIFEST.md's FIXTURE_VERSION this run was driven against.

contractVersion.description: spec/EVIDENCE-CONTRACT.md's EVIDENCE_CONTRACT_VERSION in effect for this run.

canonicalizationVersion.description: The CANONICALIZATION_VERSION in effect for this run.

legs.description: Per-leg availability and identity, keyed by leg name (data-service, dg-reasoner, csharp, replay).

comparison_rows.description: One entry per (ruleId, objectId) pair seen in any leg's envelope, ordered ascending by objectId, ties broken by ruleId (spec/EVIDENCE-CONTRACT.md section 4).

perLeg.description: Keyed by leg name. Each value is either {present: false} or {present: true, rows: [...]} -- a leg with no row for this pair is recorded as absent, never omitted.

declared_non_equivalences.description: Typed, reasoned divergences -- present in the vocabulary of unsupported/error/not_evaluated/indeterminate, each carrying a non-empty warning.

silent_disagreement_count.description: The DE-01 gate value (D-14). Must be 0 for the golden fixture to accept DE-01.
